Class GameCardController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.view.GUI.Controllers.PreGame.GameCardController
public class GameCardController extends Object
Controller for a single game card displayed in the lobby list. Shows the game id, current status and player count for one available game, and allows the player to navigate to the totem choice screen to join it.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

    • setData

      public void setData(LobbyInfoDTO dto, SceneManager sceneManager)
      Populates this card with the provided lobby data and updates all labels. Can be called multiple times to refresh the card when the lobby state changes. Disables the join button if the game is already full or has already started, since in both cases only the original players can rejoin.
      Parameters:
      dto - the lobby data to display
      sceneManager - the scene manager used to navigate on join

    • handleJoinGame

      public void handleJoinGame()
      Handles the join button action. Navigates to the totem choice screen in join mode for this specific game.
